title: Gap analysis
summary: Technical contract for diffing a promoted draft against its frozen baseline, classifying human edits, logging them, and feeding the digest back into draft prompts.
notes: No frontmatter, no filename/path convention signal (plain docs/ root). Classified on content: command signatures (gap_analyze, gap_log_list, gap_append_log, drafts_relink_promoted), a JSON log record schema, enumerated hunk fields with an op enum, an ordered first-match-wins heuristic table, and stated invariants ('Isolation invariant', 'the two must stay in sync') — these are implementation contracts the system must honor, so SPEC over DOC despite explanatory prose. Contains one 'Trade-off:' line and rationale asides but no ADR structure (no Status/Context/Decision/Consequences) and no user stories or acceptance criteria, so neither ADR nor PRD. cross_refs lists only referenced markdown docs; the many src-tauri/ and src/ code paths are implementation pointers, not doc references. Filename suffix follows the sibling '-docs' convention rather than a SHA-256 prefix: no shell tool was available in this session to compute the hash, and 'gap-analysis' is unique among current classification outputs, so collision risk is nil.
